gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Bandolier's $99 'Ring It On Set' (marked down from $148) contains the same Palmer Magnet Duet clear case with crossbody chain and wristlet that ChatGPT quoted at $98, plus a Zoe magnetic ring holder, so the premium pick comes with a grip and stand for $1 more.
standout_why: I compared against the Bandolier product pages ChatGPT got (ranks 7-9, which show the Palmer Duet at $98 alone), the AppleInsider strap roundup (rank 6, which returned HTTP 403 to me) and the Camera Lookout iPhone 18 Pro strap roundup (rank 11, which lists Apple, Peak Design, OtterBox and CASETiFY straps with no Bandolier bundle and no load or drop rating). None of them mentions the $99 set or puts current prices side by side for the case-plus-strap options.
decides: This confirms Bandolier Palmer Duet as the premium 'both straps' pick, but buying it as the $99 Ring It On Set beats paying $98 for the case alone. At the other end, Apple's $59 strap (launch price) only works on select Apple cases at $49-$59 each, so Apple's own case-plus-strap setup costs about $108-$118 at launch prices, more than the Bandolier set. Dealectric lists no strap case, and I found no ESR iPhone case with a strap, so no house product fits this page.
candidates: Bandolier Ring It On Set (Palmer Duet + Zoe ring)
Apple Crossbody Strap + Apple Silicone/Clear/TechWoven case
OtterBox 2-in-1 Crossbody Strap + anchored OtterBox case
Peak Design Mobile Crossbody Strap / Multi-Strap / Mobile Cuff
